title: Lane-Line Slide Dribble
description: Players slide sideways along the lane lines while dribbling, mimicking the lateral steps a ball handler uses to probe a defense or evade a trap.

content.objective: Move laterally in a stance while keeping the dribble on the trailing side and the shoulders square.
content.setup: Players line up at the baseline end of each lane line, a ball each.
content.organization: One player per lane line at a time.
instructions: Face the sideline in a low stance with the ball in the hand nearest the baseline.
Slide up the lane line to the free-throw line, dribbling with the trailing hand.
At the free-throw line, cross the ball over and slide back down.
Repeat three lengths, then face the other way.
Finish with a jump stop and a shot from the block.
coachingPoints: Slide: feet do not cross or click together.
Ball on the trailing side, body between ball and lane.
commonMistakes: Crossing the feet like a run.
Ball drifting in front of the body.
Rising out of the stance on the turn.
content.safety: One player per lane line; the shooter clears before the next starts.
progressions: Add a defender mirroring on the other side of the lane.
regressions: Shorter distance: block to the second hash.
variations: Hesitate and attack at the free-throw line.
successCriteria: Three lengths with the feet never crossing.
content.gameApplication: Lateral movement with the ball lets guards probe a zone or slide away from a trapping defender.
